errors.text_span: Диаграмата е разделена на четири сектора, които отговарят на четири различни категории на продължителност на дейността на организацията.
errors.evidence: The pie chart shows four slices, but the legend on the right lists five categories. The description incorrectly states there are only four categories, thus omitting the 'Под 1 година' (Under 1 year) category which presumably has 0%.

errors.text_span: като всеки етикет и съответният му процент са посочени в легендата вдясно.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the percentages are listed in the legend. The legend only contains the category labels and their corresponding color dots; the percentages are displayed inside the pie slices themselves.

errors.text_span: Вторият сектор, оцветен в оранжево, отговаря на „От 6 до 15 години“ и заема 36,4% – най-големият дял в диаграмата. Третият сектор, в тъмно червено, отговаря на „Над 1 до 5 години“ и заема 13,6%.
errors.evidence: The description mixes up the order of the sectors. Following a clockwise direction from the purple slice, the next slice is red (13.6%), followed by orange (36.4%). The description reverses this order, calling the orange slice the second and the red slice the third.

The description fails to mention one of the categories listed in the legend: 'Под 1 година' (Under 1 year). Although it has no corresponding slice (implying 0% of responses), it is still part of the chart's provided data categories.
The prompt asks to avoid comparisons unless explicitly stated in the chart. Identifying the largest share is a form of comparison/interpretation, even if visually obvious.
